research_question: Can a fixed, budget-counted physical multi-zone ToF ground-anchor pattern make RGB-camera height stably observable on fresh real parents without using a dense visual prior or evaluator truth?

independence_from_satom_r0.rationale: SATOM-R0 terminated before arm metrics because the visual prior did not establish a metric ground origin; G0 gives that role to an independent physical metric observation.

external_basis.work: Dense Metric Depth Completion from Sparse Direct Time-of-Flight Sensors
external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports the premise that extremely sparse physical dToF can alter metric-depth identifiability; does not validate this G0 estimator or gate

external_basis.work: ToF-Splatting: Dense SLAM using Sparse Time-of-Flight Depth and Multi-Frame Integration
external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports sparse-ToF plus multi-frame geometry as a viable research substrate; does not establish ground-height observability

external_basis.work: Flexible Depth Completion for Sparse and Varying Point Densities
external_basis.bounded_relevance: supports explicit treatment of sparse-point count and spatial distribution; G0 performs no depth completion

hardware_contract.range_and_quality: all 64 zones retain normalized range_m, sigma_m, status and host-monotonic timestamp
hardware_contract.registration: admitted rigid ToF-to-RGB transform plus per-zone ray table and RGB-coordinate sensor origin
hardware_contract.gravity: independently calibrated IMU-to-RGB transform and per-frame unit gravity-down in RGB coordinates
hardware_contract.reference_truth: independent rigid mechanical measurement of RGB optical-center height with uncertainty <=0.01 m

information_budget.unit: one exposed zone-range observation per sensor frame
information_budget.interpretation: VL53L8CX physically acquires a full frame; this protocol freezes an algorithmic information budget, not a measured energy or emitter-firing budget.

fresh_source_contract.parent_definition: one site-by-surface setup with a separately logged floor identity; frames or rig heights from the same setup are not separate parents

episode_grid.missing_capture_rule: every pre-registered slot remains in both streams; a missing or unusable physical sample is encoded as a complete 64-zone frame with INVALID zone status and therefore remains in the coverage denominator
episode_grid.timestamp_rule: host-monotonic timestamps must increase in frozen frame-slot order within every parent and episode

fresh_source_contract.required_challenge_content: at least one episode per parent contains a predeclared partial non-ground occluder crossing anchor zones; evaluator labels every anchor zone GROUND, NON_GROUND or UNRESOLVED

required_before_first_range_capture: exact VL53L8CX device serial and firmware/source hashes
admitted RGB intrinsics and ToF-to-RGB registration identities plus hashes
admitted IMU-to-RGB gravity registration identity plus hash
reference height instrument identity, calibration receipt and <=0.01 m uncertainty
exact eight-parent site/surface roster and nine-episode schedule per parent
exact 300-slot identity ledger per episode; no outcome-dependent deletion or denominator repair
measurement/truth writer hashes and empty exclusive artifact root

activation_receipt_executable_fields.protocol_id_and_sha256: must bind this exact frozen protocol
activation_receipt_executable_fields.parent_records: one record per frozen parent with parent_id, nonempty site_id, one frozen surface_stratum and a predeclared occluder_episode_id
activation_receipt_executable_fields.episode_records: one record per episode ID covering exactly the 3 heights by 3 pitches grid
activation_receipt_executable_fields.frozen_frame_ids: exactly 300 unique pre-capture time-slot IDs reused as the fixed denominator for every parent and episode

metrics: parent_macro and worst-parent absolute RGB-camera-height error
parent-macro and worst-parent false-ground support rate

stopping_rule.pass: G0 only establishes physical metric ground-height observability; a separately frozen equal-total-budget G1 may then be proposed, not automatically run.
stopping_rule.fail_or_not_evaluable: Close the ground/body-space SATOM family without changing G0 on opened outcomes; any future route must use a height-independent angular/TTC representation or a materially different pre-outcome metric reference.

claim_ceiling: pre-outcome physical ground-anchor protocol and mechanics only; no real G0 result, SATOM headroom, training, device deployment, product, safety, or paper authority
